news.title: Singer Chinmayi Faces Online Backlash Over Upcoming Ramayana Track
news.summary: Playback singer Chinmayi Sripada has drawn heavy criticism on social media after announcing her involvement with the Tamil version of the Jai Jai Ram song in the upcoming Ramayana film. Trolls and critics have resurfaced her past critical remarks regarding Lord Rama and Sita to question her association with the project. The Nitesh Tiwari directorial features Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi in lead roles as part of a high-profile, two-part epic.

news.title: Raghav Juyal Shares Touching Appreciation Note for Nani
news.summary: Actor Raghav Juyal has penned an emotional tribute celebrating his bond with Nani following their collaboration on Srikanth Odela's action drama, The Paradise. Raghav praised Nani as his safe space and mentor, thanking him for career guidance and personal support during filming. The gritty action movie features Nani alongside Raghav Juyal, Mohan Babu, and Kayadu Lohar.

news.title: BRS Leader KT Rama Rao Plans Theatrical Viewing of The Paradise
news.summary: BRS Working President KT Rama Rao has announced on social media that he will visit a cinema hall to watch Nani's latest film, The Paradise. KTR expressed his admiration for both Nani and director Srikanth Odela, marking a rare theatre outing for the politician. The film has drawn additional attention due to Priyadarshi portraying an MLA character whose presentation is widely associated with KCR.

news.title: Chiranjeevi's Silence on Vishwambhara Sparks Fan Speculation
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi's ongoing silence regarding the socio-fantasy movie Vishwambhara has fueled speculation that he lacks confidence in the project. While the actor has actively promoted his upcoming film Kaaka directed by Bobby, updates regarding Mallidi Vasishta's directorial have been scarce since teaser feedback highlighted VFX concerns. Fans remain eager for official news about his role as Bheemavaram Dorababu in the fantasy venture.

news.title: Vicky Kaushal Sports A Swagger-Filled Look In Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Next
news.summary: Makers of the upcoming multi-starrer Love And War have unveiled a striking first-look poster featuring Vicky Kaushal lighting a cigar with an intense expression. The Sanjay Leela Bhansali directorial also stars Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt, with each lead getting a distinct character reveal. The film is slated for a theatrical release on January 21, 2027, across Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil languages.

news.title: Hombale Films Takes Over Regional Distribution For Hanuman Ansh
news.summary: Kannada production banner Hombale Films has secured the entire South theatrical rights for the successful small-budget film Hanuman Ansh. The movie, directed and produced by Vishal Chaturvedi, draws inspiration from a book chronicling the life of Neem Karoli Baba. An official announcement regarding the release dates for Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam versions is expected shortly.

news.title: Young Tiger NTR To Grace Pre-Release Event Of Fahadh Faasil Starrer
news.summary: NTR is reportedly set to attend as the chief guest for the upcoming pre-release event of Don't Trouble The Trouble, starring Fahadh Faasil. Directed by Shashank Yeleti and presented by SS Rajamouli, the movie is scheduled to hit screens on October 2, 2026. Arka Media Works is producing the project in association with SS Karthikeya and Prasad Devineni.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi Adds Playful Humor at Sigma Pre-Release Event
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi recently lightened the mood at the Hyderabad pre-release event for the film Sigma with his trademark humor. He jokingly addressed social media trolling about blocking other actors' growth while playfully interacting with actress Faria Abdullah regarding her missed opportunity in Vishwambhara. Directed by Jason Sanjay, Sigma features Sundeep Kishan and Faria Abdullah in the lead roles and is scheduled for an October 2, 2026 release.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Confirms Sankranti 2027 Release for Kaaka
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi has provided an update on his upcoming film Kaaka, confirming that it will arrive in theaters during Sankranti 2027 on January 13, 2027. He noted that nearly 70 percent of the shooting is finished, with the entire first half and thirty percent of the second half completed. Produced by KVN Productions and directed by Bobby, the project features Anaswara Rajan and Nivetha Pethuraj alongside Chiranjeevi.

news.title: Vicky Kaushal Reveals Intense First Look Poster for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love & War
news.summary: Vicky Kaushal has shared his rugged and intense first look from Sanjay Leela Bhansali's upcoming directorial venture Love & War. The promotional poster displays the actor with facial wounds while lighting a cigarette with a vintage lighter alongside the caption, "Nazre milengi, lekin hatengi nahin!" Set against a 1960s war backdrop, the period drama also stars Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt and is slated for a worldwide release on January 21, 2027.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Crosses 100 Crore Worldwide in Two Days
news.summary: Nani's period action drama The Paradise, directed by Srikanth Odela, has raced past the 100 crore mark globally in just two days by grossing over 114 crores. The Sudhakar Cherukuri production has achieved strong numbers across the Telugu states, international markets, and the Hindi belt. With robust advance bookings, the film is poised for massive box office collections through its opening weekend.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi's Kaaka Speeds Through Production
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi's upcoming film Kaaka, directed by Bobby Kolli, is moving forward at an impressive pace. The team has completely wrapped up the first half and finished nearly 30% of the second half, with music director S Thaman already working on the background score. The movie remains on schedule for a theatrical release during Sankranti 2027.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Recalls Being Dropped Due to Leading Man's Spouse
news.summary: Actress Taapsee Pannu shared one of the most unusual experiences of her career where she was replaced in a movie after her dates were already confirmed. She was informed that the hero's wife disliked her, leading to her removal from the project. Taapsee noted that dealing with such unexpected decisions is challenging given the extensive planning actors invest in blocking dates.

news.title: High Stakes for Mythri Film Distributors in Nizam
news.summary: Mythri Film Distributors faces a critical phase in the Nizam region as they heavily invest in multiple high-profile projects over a short four-week span. With films like The Paradise, AK47, Jailer 2, and Ranabaali lined up, the distribution house is taking massive financial gambles to cement its market presence. Fortunately, shared partnerships among distributors help distribute the heavy financial risks involved.

news.title: Venkatesh and Trivikram's Family Drama Shifts Schedule as Special Track Nears Release
news.summary: The Venkatesh and Trivikram family entertainer Aadarsha Kutumbam has shifted its theatrical release from October 2 to October 9. Consequently, its promotional rollout has adjusted, with a special musical track featuring the lead cast slated for release tomorrow. The high-profile production features music by Thaman and a strong supporting ensemble under Haarika & Hassine Creations.

news.title: Nani and The Paradise Team Face Early Box Office Realities Following Mixed Feedback
news.summary: Despite facing mixed initial reactions and heavy social media trolling, Nani's starrer The Paradise secured a record-breaking opening day of over ₹75 crore. The film retained notable occupancy on its second day as audiences continued to check out the theatrical release. Key team members, including the lead actor and director Srikanth Odela, are addressing the feedback during scheduled press interactions.

news.title: Preity Mukhundhan Lands Lead Role Opposite Dhanush in D56
news.summary: Actress Preity Mukhundhan has officially joined the cast of Dhanush's 56th film, directed by Tamizharasan Pachamuthu. The project launched its production with a traditional pooja ceremony in Tamil Nadu, featuring a supporting cast that includes SJ Suryah and Vadivelu. This marks another major milestone for the rising actress alongside her upcoming Telugu commitments.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Faces Steep Overseas Decline After Record International Start
news.summary: Nani's latest international release, The Paradise, recorded a massive overseas debut by pulling in $2.3 million on its opening day. However, the film experienced a sharp revenue drop on its second day, adding only $250K to push its two-day offshore total to $2.55 million. The sudden deceleration follows critical feedback impacting theatrical momentum in overseas markets.

news.title: Keerthy Suresh's Dorothy Sparks Debate Over Queer Narrative
news.summary: Keerthy Suresh traveled to the Toronto International Film Festival to promote her latest Tamil feature, Dorothy, directed by Karthik Subbaraj. Following its theatrical release, the movie drew mixed responses and heavy online trolling, primarily centered around its second-half queer theme and controversial climax. While critics and certain viewers appreciated the project, the narrative's bold choices sparked significant division among audiences.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Addresses Online Trolls With Self-Deprecating Humor
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi surprised attendees and online followers at the Sigma pre-release event by jokingly poking fun at internet memes targeting his career. While busy filming Kaaka under Bobby's direction for a Sankranthi 2027 release, the veteran actor playfully quipped to co-star Faria Abdullah about restricting his growth. His witty counter to online negativity quickly became a massive talking point across social media platforms.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Compares Sundeep Kishan's Drive to His Own Early Days
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi attended the pre-release event of Sundeep Kishan's upcoming film Sigma as the chief guest. Directed by debutant Jason Sanjay and slated for an October 2 release through Mythri Distributions, the fun heist action drama drew praise from Chiranjeevi, who noted that Sundeep's hunger for unique scripts mirrors his own early career. The event also featured energetic dance performances and optimistic remarks about S Thaman's musical score.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Sustains Momentum on Second Day
news.summary: Despite receiving mixed word of mouth, Nani's latest starrer managed to pull in over Rs. 20 crores gross worldwide on a regular working day. Trade analysts noted that strong footfalls in the Nizam sector helped the project maintain steady box-office numbers.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda Sports a Fierce Avatar in New Ranabaali Poster
news.summary: The creators of the upcoming period action drama have released fresh promotional material featuring the lead actor as a 19th-century warrior. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, the pan-India project is scheduled to arrive in cinemas worldwide during the Vijayadashami festival.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi's Kaaka Commences Dubbing with Traditional Ceremony
news.summary: Following their previous collaboration, actor Chiranjeevi and filmmaker Bobby Kolli have officially launched the post-production phase of their upcoming action entertainer. Backed by KVN Productions, the film is slated for a worldwide theatrical rollout during the upcoming festive season.
